Package kieker.analysis.plugin.filter.select

Class TypeFilter

java.lang.Object
kieker.analysis.analysisComponent.AbstractAnalysisComponent
kieker.analysis.plugin.AbstractPlugin
kieker.analysis.plugin.filter.AbstractFilterPlugin
kieker.analysis.plugin.filter.select.TypeFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
IAnalysisComponent, IFilterPlugin, IPlugin
@Deprecated public final class TypeFilter extends AbstractFilterPlugin
Deprecated.
since 1.15.1 old plugin api
This filter has exactly one input port and one output port. Only the specified objects are forwarded to the output port. All other objects are forwarded to the output-not port.
Since:
1.5
